items.ja: ほら、白状しなよ。クライミングジムの彼とはどうなったの？ →「別に。2回出かけただけ。」
items.speaker: daisy-mae
choices: Nothing much. We went out twice, that's all.
Sorry, I'll grab a towel.
The climbing gym's right around the corner.
items.note: spill＝白状して（話して）。こぼすではない

items.en: You beat me fair and square. Rematch next Sunday?
items.ja: 正々堂々、君の勝ちだ。来週の日曜にリベンジ戦はどう？ →「受けて立つよ。次も手加減しないから。」
items.speaker: hamlet
choices: You're on. I won't go easy on you, though.
Sorry, I didn't mean to hit you.
Sunday at the square? Sure.
items.note: beat＝勝つ。fair and square＝正々堂々

items.en: Between you and me, I thought it was a little overrated.
items.ja: ここだけの話、ちょっと評判倒れだと思ったな。 →「わかる。後半ちょっとダレたよね。」
items.speaker: beau
choices: Same. The second half really dragged.
Yeah, it's rated R.
Between us? Sure, I'll sit in the middle.
items.note: overrated＝評判ほどではない。率直な不満

items.en: So my friend wants to set you up with her cousin. Interested?
items.ja: でね、友だちが自分のいとこをあなたに紹介したいんだって。興味ある？ →「うーん、どんな人か次第かな。」
items.speaker: molly
choices: Maybe. Depends what he's like.
Sure, I'll set it up on the table.
Yes, my cousin's really interested.
items.note: set A up with B＝AにBを紹介（恋愛）。設置ではない

items.en: My in-laws are coming for Thanksgiving. For ten days. Ten whole days.
items.ja: 義理の両親が感謝祭に来るの。10日間も。まるまる10日よ。 →「10日も？ それは大変だね。」
items.speaker: pekoe
choices: Ten days? Good luck with that.
Just ten? That's not too many people.
Thanksgiving's always on a Thursday.
items.note: ten days＝滞在日数。人数の話ではない

items.en: Can I bring anything on Saturday?
items.ja: 土曜日、何か持っていこうか？ →「手ぶらで大丈夫。まあ、飲み物くらいかな。」
items.speaker: rosie
choices: Just yourself. Well, maybe something to drink.
Yes, I'll bring it back on Saturday.
No, I can't make Saturday.
items.note: 手土産の申し出。持ち帰る話ではない

items.en: Wait, you made this? This is seriously good.
items.ja: えっ、これ作ったの？ ほんとにおいしい。 →「ありがとう！ ネットで見つけたレシピだけどね。」
items.speaker: label
choices: Thanks! It's just a recipe I found online.
Sorry, I'll make it better next time.
No, I didn't wait for you.
items.note: 褒められたら謝らずお礼を。謙遜しすぎない

items.en: I owe you one for covering my shift. Seriously.
items.ja: シフト代わってくれて借りができたよ。ほんとに。 →「気にしないで。今度コーヒーおごってね。」
items.speaker: kid-cat
choices: Don't mention it. Buy me a coffee sometime.
Sure. How much do I owe you?
Yes, I covered it with a sheet.
items.note: I owe you one＝恩に着る。金額の話ではない

items.en: Dude, I think he's getting cold feet about the wedding.
items.ja: なあ、あいつ結婚式のことで怖気づいてると思うんだ。 →「え、本当？ なんでそう思うの？」
items.speaker: fang
choices: Really? What makes you say that?
Maybe he needs thicker socks.
Yeah, the wedding's in winter.
items.note: get cold feet＝怖気づく。寒さの話ではない

items.en: Sorry, sorry, the subway was packed. Have you been waiting long?
items.ja: ごめんごめん、地下鉄がぎゅうぎゅうで。だいぶ待った？ →「ううん、私も今来たところ。」
items.speaker: shep
choices: No, I just got here myself.
Yes, the subway's usually faster.
That's okay, I'll wait for the next one.
items.note: packed＝超満員。聞かれたのは待ち時間

items.en: As I mentioned in my last email, the deadline was Tuesday.
items.ja: 前回のメールでお伝えした通り、締め切りは火曜日でした。 → つまり、メールを読んでいないことに苛立っている。
items.speaker: lily
choices: She's annoyed that you didn't read her email.
She's checking which day the deadline is.
She forgot to send you the email.
items.note: As I mentioned＝前にも言ったでしょ、という苛立ち

items.en: Great question. Let's, uh, circle back to that once we've got more data.
items.ja: いい質問だね。えー、データがもっと揃ったらまた戻ろう。 → つまり、今は答えたくない。
items.speaker: bob
choices: He's putting the question off for now.
He'll answer it right after the meeting.
He thinks the question is easy to answer.
items.note: circle back＝後で戻る。体のいい先送り

items.en: Launching in December? Wow. That's... ambitious.
items.ja: 12月にローンチ？ わあ。それは…野心的ね。 → つまり、無謀だと思っている。
items.speaker: francine
choices: She thinks it's a risky, bad idea.
She admires how bold the team is.
She wants to launch even earlier.
items.note: ambitious の前の間(ま)＝無謀だ、の婉曲

items.en: Could you stop by my office when you get a minute? And close the door behind you.
items.ja: 手が空いたら、ちょっと私の部屋に来てくれる？ ドアは閉めてね。 → つまり、内密で深刻な話がある。
items.speaker: gulliver
choices: He wants a private, serious talk.
He wants you to fix his office door.
He needs a minute to finish something first.
items.note: ドアを閉めて＝内密で深刻な話の合図

items.en: It's on my list. It's just, you know, not exactly at the top of it.
items.ja: リストには入ってるよ。ただまあ、一番上ってわけじゃないけど。 → つまり、当分やらない。
items.speaker: anchovy
choices: He won't get to it any time soon.
He's about to do it next.
He's lost the list somewhere.
items.note: not exactly at the top＝後回し。やるとは言っていない

items.en: It might be worth having someone with fresh eyes go over the figures.
items.ja: 数字は、新しい目で誰かに見直してもらってもいいかもしれないわね。 → つまり、数字に間違いがありそう。
items.speaker: reneigh
choices: She suspects there are mistakes in the figures.
She wants to hire a new analyst.
She's happy with the figures as they are.
items.note: might be worth＝遠回しな指摘。数字を疑っている

items.en: Don't worry, everyone's a little lost their first month. It's a steep learning curve.
items.ja: 心配しないで、最初の1か月はみんなちょっと迷うから。覚えることが多いんだよ。 → つまり、最初は大変で当然。
items.speaker: stitches
choices: It's normal to find it hard at first.
You're learning more slowly than others.
The office is hard to find at first.
items.note: steep learning curve＝覚えることが多くて大変

items.en: Your résumé says you're a perfectionist. We'll see how long that lasts here.
items.ja: 履歴書に完璧主義とありますね。ここでいつまで続くか、見ものです。 → つまり、ここは忙しいという冗談。
items.speaker: henry
choices: He's joking that this job is too busy for perfection.
He doesn't believe what's on your résumé.
He wants you to stop being a perfectionist.
items.note: 面接官の乾いた冗談。疑い・拒絶ではない

items.en: We'll definitely keep you in mind for future projects.
items.ja: 今後のプロジェクトの際には、ぜひ検討させていただきます。 → つまり、今回は不採用。
items.speaker: agnes
choices: You didn't get this project.
You've already won the next project.
They'll call you tomorrow about it.
items.note: keep you in mind＝今回は見送り、の定型句

items.en: Sorry, I think you might still be sharing your screen. Including your messages.
items.ja: ごめん、まだ画面共有になってるかも。メッセージも含めて。 → つまり、個人チャットがみんなに見えている。
items.speaker: maple
choices: Everyone can see your private chats.
Your screen has frozen.
She wants you to share your screen.
items.note: Including…が本題。気まずい事態を遠回しに

items.en: Pineapple and blue cheese? Well, to each their own, I guess.
items.ja: パイナップルとブルーチーズ？ まあ、人それぞれよね。 → つまり、変な組み合わせだと思っている。
items.speaker: gayle
choices: She thinks it's a strange combination.
She'd like to try some too.
She can't decide what to order.
items.note: to each their own＝人それぞれ（私は無理）

items.en: The soundtrack was great. The rest of it... I've seen better.
items.ja: 音楽はよかった。ほかは…まあ、もっといいのを見たことあるかな。 → つまり、映画はいまいちだった。
items.speaker: kk-slider
choices: He didn't think much of the movie.
He saw it more than once.
He loved everything except the music.
items.note: I've seen better＝いまいち。何度も見たではない

items.en: I'm not saying she's the reason they split up. I'm just saying the timing's interesting.
items.ja: 彼女が別れた原因だなんて言ってないよ。ただ、タイミングが気になるってだけ。 → つまり、彼女が原因だとほのめかしている。
items.speaker: bunnie
choices: She's hinting that the woman caused the breakup.
She's sure the woman had nothing to do with it.
She's asking when they broke up.
items.note: I'm not saying…＝実はそう言っている

items.en: Proposing at her work party? I mean, it's your call, but it might be a bit much.
items.ja: 彼女の会社のパーティーでプロポーズ？ まあ、決めるのはあなただけど、ちょっとやりすぎかも。 → つまり、やめたほうがいい。
items.speaker: goldie
choices: She thinks it's a bad idea.
She thinks the party will cost too much.
She wants him to call her about it.
items.note: it's your call＝あなた次第。a bit much＝やりすぎ

items.en: Camping? In February? Yeah... I'll let you know.
items.ja: キャンプ？ 2月に？ うーん…また連絡するよ。 → つまり、行きたくない。
items.speaker: cj
choices: He doesn't really want to go.
He'll check the weather and decide.
He's excited about going in February.
items.note: 間と気のない声が本音。let you know＝たぶん断る

items.en: Put your wallet away. I got this.
items.ja: 財布はしまって。ここは俺が払う。 → つまり、彼が払う。
items.speaker: kabuki
choices: He's paying for everyone.
He's going to get the waiter.
He wants you to pay in cash.
items.note: I got this＝ここは任せて（おごる）。米口語

items.en: I hate to be that person, but you did say you'd be here by seven.
items.ja: こういうこと言いたくないけど、7時までに来るって言ったよね。 → つまり、遅刻に文句を言っている。
items.speaker: tammy
choices: She's complaining that you're late.
She hates it when people arrive early.
She's asking what time it is.
items.note: I hate to be that person, but…＝苦情の前置き

items.en: My mom's 'just stopping by' on Sunday. So, you know, maybe clean up the guest room?
items.ja: 日曜に母が「ちょっと寄る」んだって。だから、ね、客間を片付けてくれる？ → つまり、母が来るから片付けてほしい。
items.speaker: bea
choices: She wants the room cleaned before her mom visits.
Her mom is moving into the guest room.
Her mom can't come on Sunday after all.
items.note: stopping by＝ちょっと寄る。でも本題は片付け

items.en: Oh wow, you look way better than your photos! Sorry, that came out wrong.
items.ja: わあ、写真よりずっと素敵！ ごめん、今の言い方まずかった。 → つまり、褒めるつもりが失言した。
items.speaker: rosie
choices: She meant it as a compliment but said it badly.
She thinks your photos look better than you.
She doesn't recognize you from your photos.
items.note: that came out wrong＝言い方を間違えた

items.en: Jazz? It's not really my cup of tea, but I'll come along for the company.
items.ja: ジャズ？ あまり好みじゃないけど、付き合いで行くよ。 → つまり、好きではないが一緒に行く。
items.speaker: octavian
choices: He doesn't love jazz, but he'll still go.
He'd rather stay in and have tea.
He loves jazz and can't wait.
items.note: not my cup of tea＝好みでない。でも付き合いで行く

items.en: We're going to have to push the review to Thursday.
items.ja: レビューは木曜に延ばさざるを得ないな。
items.speaker: pietro
choices: We're going to have to
We were going to
We'd love to
items.note: gonna hafta＝〜せざるを得ない。were なら過去
items.tts: We're gonna hafta push the review to Thursday.

items.en: What do you want to do about the printer?
items.ja: プリンター、どうしたい？
items.speaker: kicks
choices: What do you want to
What did you want to
Where do you want to
items.note: whaddaya＝what do you。did you なら「ワッジャ」
items.tts: Whaddaya wanna do about the printer?

items.en: I've been meaning to ask you about your trip.
items.ja: 旅行のこと、ずっと聞こうと思ってたんだ。
items.speaker: maple
choices: I've been meaning
I'd been meaning
I was meaning
items.note: I've been meaning to＝ずっと〜しようと思っていた
items.tts: I've been meanin' to ask ya about your trip.

items.en: Have you had a chance to look at the contract?
items.ja: 契約書、もうご覧いただけましたか？
items.speaker: nana
choices: Have you had
Did you have
Do you have
items.note: had は弱く「ヤド」。Did you have と聞き分け
items.tts: Have ya had a chance ta look at the contract?

items.en: Weren't we supposed to hear back by now?
items.ja: もう返事が来ててもいい頃じゃなかった？
items.speaker: tia
choices: Weren't we
Aren't we
Won't we
items.note: Weren't「ワーント」と Aren't「アーント」の差
items.tts: Weren't we s'posed to hear back by now?

items.en: Could you just send me the link again?
items.ja: リンク、もう一回送ってもらえる？
items.speaker: audie
choices: Could you
Would you
Did you
items.note: Could you は「クッジュ」。Would you は w で始まる
items.tts: Couldja just send me the link again?

items.en: You shouldn't have told him about the party.
items.ja: あいつにパーティーのこと、言うべきじゃなかったよ。
items.speaker: wolfgang
choices: shouldn't have
should have
wouldn't have
items.note: shouldn't've の n't を聞き逃すと意味が逆に
items.tts: You shouldn't've told 'im about the party.

items.en: I used to play in a band, believe it or not.
items.ja: 信じないかもしれないけど、昔バンドやってたんだ。
items.speaker: kk-slider
choices: used to
get to
want to
items.note: used to＝昔は〜した。「ユースタ」と一語に
items.tts: I useta play in a band, believe it or not.

items.en: She must have left already. Her coat's gone.
items.ja: 彼女もう帰ったんだね。コートがないもん。
items.speaker: molly
choices: must have
might have
would have
items.note: musta＝must have。mighta とは母音で区別
items.tts: She musta left already. Her coat's gone.

items.en: You'd better book it now. It'll sell out.
items.ja: 今すぐ予約したほうがいいよ。売り切れちゃうから。
items.speaker: katt
choices: You'd better
We'd better
You'd rather
items.note: You'd better の 'd はほぼ聞こえない
items.tts: Ya better book it now. It'll sell out.

items.en: Didn't you say you'd already booked it?
items.ja: もう予約したって言ってなかった？
items.speaker: bunnie
choices: Didn't you
Did you
Don't you
items.note: Didn't you は「ディドンチャ」。t と y がつながる
items.tts: Didncha say you'd already booked it?

items.en: What's he been up to lately?
items.ja: あの人、最近どうしてるの？
items.speaker: daisy-mae
choices: What's he been
What's she been
What have you been
items.note: he の h が落ちて「ワッツィ」。she なら sh が残る
items.tts: What's 'e been up to lately?

items.en: Are you going to watch the game tonight?
items.ja: 今夜の試合、見る？
items.speaker: hamlet
choices: Are you going to
Do you want to
Were you going to
items.note: Are you going to →「ヤガナ」。are はほぼ消える
items.tts: Ya gonna watch the game tonight?

items.en: I don't know where they went.
items.ja: あいつら、どこに行ったんだろう。わからないな。
items.speaker: frett
choices: I don't know
I didn't know
I do know
items.note: dunno＝don't know。didn't なら d が残る
items.tts: I dunno where they went.

items.en: We came in at 1.2 million, about 15% under budget.
items.ja: 120万で着地しました。予算より15%ほど下回りました。
items.speaker: tom-nook
items.note: fifTEEN は後ろに強勢。1.2 は金額で別の数字
items.tts: We came in at one point two million, about fifteen percent under budget.
items.ask: 予算を どれだけ下回った？

items.en: Sales were up 8% in Q3. Sorry, Q2. Q3 was flat.
items.ja: 売上は第3四半期に8%増…失礼、第2四半期です。第3四半期は横ばいでした。
items.speaker: zucker
choices: Q2（第2四半期）
Q3（第3四半期）
Q4（第4四半期）
items.note: Sorry の後が訂正。flat＝横ばい
items.tts: Sales were up eight percent in Q three. Sorry, Q two. Q three was flat.

items.en: My direct line's 312-555-0147, or just call the front desk and ask for extension 38.
items.ja: 直通は312-555-0147です。または受付に電話して、内線38をお呼びください。
items.speaker: tammy
items.note: 長い直通番号に気を取られず、内線を拾う
items.tts: My direct line's three-one-two, five-five-five, oh-one-four-seven, or just call the front desk and ask for extension thirty-eight.

items.en: Can we say the 13th? No, wait, that's a Friday. Let's make it the 16th.
items.ja: 13日でいい？ あ、待って、金曜日だ。16日にしよう。
items.speaker: judy
items.note: No, wait の後が決定。thirTEEN／sixTEEN
items.tts: Can we say the thirteenth? No, wait, that's a Friday. Let's make it the sixteenth.

items.en: We're down to 40 for the offsite, so book a room for 45 to be safe.
items.ja: 社外研修は40人に減ったから、念のため45人分の部屋を取っておいて。
items.speaker: pietro
items.note: to be safe＝念のため多めに。40は参加人数
items.tts: We're down to forty for the offsite, so book a room for forty-five to be safe.
items.ask: 何人分の部屋を とる？

items.en: The position starts at $72K, going up to $78K after your first 90 days.
items.ja: このポジションは年収7万2千ドルから、最初の90日を過ぎると7万8千ドルになります。
items.speaker: shep
items.note: K＝thousand（千）。after の後が上がった額
items.tts: The position starts at seventy-two K, going up to seventy-eight K after your first ninety days.

items.en: The call's at 7 p.m. our time, so that's 9 a.m. for you in Tokyo. Wait, no, 8. We're on daylight saving time.
items.ja: 電話会議はこっちの夜7時だから、東京は朝9時…いや待って、8時だ。こっちは今サマータイムだから。
items.speaker: marina
choices: 朝8時
朝9時
朝7時
items.note: Wait, no の後が正しい時刻（夏時間で1時間ずれる）
items.tts: The call's at seven p.m. our time, so that's nine a.m. for you in Tokyo. Wait, no, eight. We're on daylight saving time.

items.en: Your laptop should arrive in 3 to 5 business days. Your badge, another 2 on top of that.
items.ja: ノートPCは3〜5営業日で届くはず。社員証はさらにその2日後。
items.speaker: stitches
choices: 7営業日
5営業日
2営業日
items.note: on top of that＝さらに上乗せ。最長は5＋2
items.tts: Your laptop should arrive in three to five business days. Your badge, another two on top of that.
items.ask: 社員証は 最長で 何営業日後？

items.en: Tickets were 85 bucks each, but with fees it came to 210 for both.
items.ja: チケットは1枚85ドルだったけど、手数料込みで2枚210ドルになった。
items.speaker: kk-slider
items.note: two-ten＝210。手数料込みの合計を聞いている
items.tts: Tickets were eighty-five bucks each, but with fees it came to two-ten for both.

items.en: We were up 5-2 in the seventh and lost 6-5. Don't ask.
items.ja: 7回には5対2でリードしてたのに、6対5で負けた。聞かないで。
items.speaker: dom
choices: 6対5で負け
5対2で勝ち
6対2で負け
items.note: in the seventh（7回）は途中経過。lost の後が結果
items.tts: We were up five-two in the seventh and lost six-five. Don't ask.

items.en: We're setting up at 7, so don't come before half past. She gets there at quarter to 8.
items.ja: 7時から準備するから、7時半より前には来ないで。主役は7時45分に着くから。
items.speaker: rosie
items.note: half past＝7時半。quarter to 8 は主役の到着
items.tts: We're setting up at seven, so don't come before half past. She gets there at quarter to eight.
items.ask: 何時以降に 来てほしい？

items.en: Rent's 2,400 a month, so 800 each. Plus utilities, so more like 950.
items.ja: 家賃は月2,400ドルだから1人800。光熱費を足すと、950くらいかな。
items.speaker: reneigh
items.note: more like＝むしろ〜くらい。最後が光熱費込み
items.tts: Rent's twenty-four hundred a month, so eight hundred each. Plus utilities, so more like nine-fifty.
items.ask: 光熱費込みで 1人いくら？

items.en: Bake it at 350 for 25 minutes. Actually, make it 20, my oven runs hot.
items.ja: 350度（華氏）で25分焼いて。やっぱり20分にして、うちのオーブン火が強いから。
items.speaker: molly
items.note: Actually の後が訂正。350は温度（華氏）
items.tts: Bake it at three-fifty for twenty-five minutes. Actually, make it twenty, my oven runs hot.

items.en: I finished in 4:12. My goal was under four, so... next year.
items.ja: 4時間12分でゴールした。目標は4時間切りだったから…また来年だな。
items.speaker: dom
choices: 4時間12分
4時間ちょうど

items.speaker: audie

She really liked him and wants a second date.
She wants to join his fantasy league.
items.note: nice だけ＋Like, a lot.＝退屈だった

items.ja: もっと大きいトラックを借りないとだめだね。ソファだけで入らないよ。

We were going to
We want to

Let's
Let him

items.ja: みんなで「サプライズ！」って叫んだときのあいつの顔、見せたかったよ。
items.speaker: frett

shouldn't have
could've

Can you
Could you

have to
get to

could've
wouldn't have

I'd like to

items.speaker: label

items.tts: The book's twenty-four dollars, and with tax that comes to twenty-six sixteen. Do you need a bag?

items.tts: The picnic pavilion's seventy-five for four hours, and the grill's another twenty.

items.ja: おばあちゃんのレシピだと小麦粉1カップ半。でもそれは4人分。あなたは8人分作るんでしょ。

1.5カップ
8カップ

items.ja: リンデン・アベニュー1630番地、青い家だよ。リンデン・ストリートじゃないよ、それは町の反対側。

items.tts: It's sixteen-thirty Linden Avenue, the blue house. Not Linden Street, that's across town.

It's gone without the old passcode.
It's only saved with the photos.

lines.ja: あの単語ゲームのハイスコアは消えるのかい？

Could you send it in ten minutes instead?
No, it was five times, not ten.

His mom is coming to her birthday.
